headline: How to Get Leafy
title: How to Get Leafy in Aniimo | Pranky Evolution Steps | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Leafy is not a simple level up. Pranky must reach level twenty first. Then you need to beat the Alpha Leafy, a grass boss in the Mistwoods. The evolution also has to happen on the giant lotus leaf where that Alpha lives, so do it there. Most guides list a Sprout Stone as the material. Check the evolution panel to confirm. Have you beaten Alpha Leafy yet? Comment below!
description: How to get Leafy in Aniimo: level Pranky to 20, beat the Alpha Leafy in the Mistwoods and evolve on the giant lotus leaf.
